See [[#Behind the scenes|more]] }} '''Freesiders''' are residents of [[Freeside]] in [[New Vegas]], appearing in [[Fallout TV series season 2|season 2]] of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== {{section|FOTV}} ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Handoff]]=== {{section|FOTV}} ==Notable Freesiders== * [[Freeside child in charge]] * [[Freeside child hustler]] * [[Freeside child selling drugs]] * [[Freeside croupier]] * [[Freeside customer]] * [[Freeside gambler]] * [[Freeside showgirl]]s ==Appearances== Freesiders appear {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances |13=205 |14=206 |15=207 |16=208 }} ==Behind the scenes== Three Freesiders are credited for speaking roles in the episode "[[The Handoff]]." They are played by [[Derek Anunciation]], [[John W. Lawson]], and [[Sonia Jackson]]. Other Freesiders are portrayed by various uncredited background actors and stunt performers, including in episodes prior to "The Handoff."
